snippet.description:
Preparing for UPSC CSE 2027? Don’t make the mistake of waiting until Prelims to start your Mains preparation.

For a serious UPSC 2027 aspirant, Mains preparation should be completed well before Prelims. By December 2026, your Mains syllabus should be covered, PYQs should be attempted, and your answer-writing and test preparation should already be in place.

In this video, understand why planning Mains preparation in advance is crucial for UPSC 2027 and why the “Prelims ke baad Mains karenge” approach can put your entire preparation under pressure.

The goal should be simple: After Prelims, revise and refine—not start Mains preparation from scratch.

If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027, this is one mistake you cannot afford to make.
